reasons.action: The brief asks only for an endpoint dissolve between the two supplied pictures; it requests no new or performed behavior, so the observed poses and actions remain reference-governed.
reasons.medium: The structured style permission explicitly converts to the watercolour storybook target, so medium is request-governed.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory change is requested, so the figures' observed wardrobe remains reference-governed.
reasons.lighting: No instruction about light, an illuminating source, its direction or visible quality is given; the endpoint dissolve does not authorize replacing the references' lighting.
reasons.framing: The brief specifies only aspect ratio and endpoint preservation, not a camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint or movement; framing therefore remains reference-governed.
reasons.palette: There is no explicit requested grade or tonal-contrast treatment; the dissolve instruction does not regrade the scene, so palette remains reference-governed.
